using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Linq;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.MediaEncoding;
using MediaBrowser.Model.Dto;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace MediaBrowser.Controller.Tests.MediaEncoding
{
    public class TranscodingJobTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<TranscodingJob>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly TranscodingJob _job;

        public TranscodingJobTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<TranscodingJob>>();
            _job = new TranscodingJob(_loggerMock.Object);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Stop_ProcessNotExited_WritesQAndWaitFails_LogsKillingFFmpegProcess()
        {
            // Arrange
            _job.Path = "/test/path/ffmpeg.mp4";
            _job.HasExited = false;
            _job.Process = new Mock<Process>().Object;
            Mock.Get(_job.Process).Setup(p => p.StandardInput).Returns(new Mock<StreamWriter>(new MemoryStream()).Object);
            Mock.Get(_job.Process).Setup(p => p.WaitForExit(5000)).Returns(false);

            // Act
            _job.Stop();

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    0,
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => ContainsMessage(v, "Killing FFmpeg process for /test/path/ffmpeg.mp4")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Stop_ProcessNotExited_WritesQAndWaitSucceeds_DoesNotLogKillingFFmpegProcess()
        {
            // Arrange
            _job.Path = "/test/path/ffmpeg.mp4";
            _job.HasExited = false;
            _job.Process = new Mock<Process>().Object;
            Mock.Get(_job.Process).Setup(p => p.StandardInput).Returns(new Mock<StreamWriter>(new MemoryStream()).Object);
            Mock.Get(_job.Process).Setup(p => p.WaitForExit(5000)).Returns(true);

            // Act
            _job.Stop();

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    0,
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => ContainsMessage(v, "Killing FFmpeg process")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Never);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Stop_HasExited_DoesNotLogKillingFFmpegProcess()
        {
            // Arrange
            _job.HasExited = true;

            // Act
            _job.Stop();

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    0,
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => ContainsMessage(v, "Killing FFmpeg process")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Never);
        }

        private static bool ContainsMessage<TState>(TState state, string expectedMessage)
        {
            return state?.ToString()?.Contains(expectedMessage) == true;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.MediaEncoding;
using MediaBrowser.Model.Dto;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Moq.Language.Flow;
using Xunit;

namespace MediaBrowser.Controller.Tests.MediaEncoding
{
    public class TranscodingJobTests : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<TranscodingJob>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly TranscodingJob _job;

        public TranscodingJobTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<TranscodingJob>>();
            _loggerMock.Setup(x => x.Log(It.IsAny<LogLevel>(), It.IsAny<EventId>(), It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(), It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()));
            _job = new TranscodingJob(_loggerMock.Object);
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            _job?.Dispose();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Stop_ProcessNotExited_WritesQAndWaitFails_LogsKillingFFmpegProcess()
        {
            // Arrange
            _job.Path = "/test/path/ffmpeg.mp4";
            _job.HasExited = false;
            
            var processMock = new Mock<Process>();
            var stdInMock = new Mock<StreamWriter>(new MemoryStream());
            processMock.Setup(p => p.StandardInput).Returns(stdInMock.Object);
            processMock.Setup(p => p.WaitForExit(5000)).Returns(false);
            _job.Process = processMock.Object;

            // Act
            _job.Stop();

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.LogInformation("Killing FFmpeg process for {Path}", "/test/path/ffmpeg.mp4"),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Stop_ProcessNotExited_WritesQAndWaitSucceeds_DoesNotLogKillingFFmpegProcess()
        {
            // Arrange
            _job.Path = "/test/path/ffmpeg.mp4";
            _job.HasExited = false;
            
            var processMock = new Mock<Process>();
            var stdInMock = new Mock<StreamWriter>(new MemoryStream());
            processMock.Setup(p => p.StandardInput).Returns(stdInMock.Object);
            processMock.Setup(p => p.WaitForExit(5000)).Returns(true);
            _job.Process = processMock.Object;

            // Act
            _job.Stop();

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.LogInformation("Killing FFmpeg process for {Path}", "/test/path/ffmpeg.mp4"),
                Times.Never);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Stop_HasExited_DoesNotLogKillingFFmpegProcess()
        {
            // Arrange
            _job.HasExited = true;

            // Act
            _job.Stop();

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.LogInformation("Killing FFmpeg process for {Path}", It.IsAny<string>()),
                Times.Never);
        }
    }
}
